blocks.heading: A SHARED SPACE FOR HOLDERS
blocks.body: Bunker was a 3D metaverse experience designed as a place for Dronies holders to meet and spend time inside the world of the project. We hired a developer to build the experience; I led the creative and art direction, connected the work to the broader brand and story, and coordinated production across the people involved.

title: METAVERSE_BUNKER.DIR
heading: METAVERSE BUNKER
description: A 3D metaverse hangout created for Dronies holders, extending the collection’s world into a shared community space.
